system.description:
On command, the wearer becomes invisible, as the invisibility spell, until the wearer attacks or casts a spell. Items the wearer carries become invisible with the wearer and turn visible again if dropped.

Separately, the armor itself can be made invisible three times per day. Item invisibility does not hide the wearer and is tracked manually.

Apply the Invisible condition from the chat card for the wearer.
system.duration: Until the wearer attacks or casts a spell
